description: Per-frame K / 3 cube-VPs / ad-unit / cube vertices, multi-method (NBA shots 2 & 7).

columns.method: K-estimation algorithm (see methods list); distinguishes K variants
columns.f_ref_px: method focal at ref frame; the value used in K (per-frame, const per shot+method)
columns.f_frame_px: == f_ref_px (K focal). Kept for schema stability.
columns.f_frame_raw: EXPERIMENTAL per-frame focal estimate from center(H_i).K_ref; on this low-rotation footage it is mostly unobservable/noisy -- use only where f_frame_reliable is true, else ignore
columns.f_frame_reliable: bool: per-frame focal self-consistent + rotation observable (rare here)
columns.tilt_deg: floor-normal tilt of this method (const per shot+method)
columns.K: 3x3 row-major intrinsics from f_frame_px, pp at (cx,cy)
columns.vp_len: cube X-axis VP (court length r1), homogeneous [x,y,w] px in THIS frame
columns.vp_wid: cube Y-axis VP (court width r2), homogeneous
columns.vp_up: cube Z-axis VP (floor normal r3), homogeneous (w~0 => at infinity)
columns.has_ad_quad: bool: ad_quad is tracked (True) or H-propagated from ref (False)
columns.cube_verts: 8 cube vertices (x,y) order [b0,b1,b2,b3,t0,t1,t2,t3]; bottom=ad_quad ring, top[k] above bottom[k] (extruded along floor normal)
